description: Blalock Seafood & Specialty Market is the premier source for fresh seafood on the Alabama Gulf Coast. Located in Gulf Shores, AL, our fish, seafood, and shrimp market has provided high-quality seafood and gourmet items to the region for more than 10 years. With some of the best locally caught seafood around, we're dedicated to your satisfaction. We serve our customers with pride, providing one of the widest selections of seafood in the area.

raw_text_content: Blalock Seafood & Specialty Market. Seafood Market in Gulf Shores, AL. Blalock Seafood & Specialty Market in Gulf Shores, AL, is the premier seafood market and provider of fine wines. Call us at (251) 968-5811 for fresh seafood. Premier source for fresh seafood on the Alabama Gulf Coast. High-quality seafood and gourmet items for more than 10 years. Widest selections of seafood in the area. Free Pack to Travel - Our team of seafood experts can professionally wrap and seal your purchases to ensure they're packed safely for travel home. Steamed Meal Solutions - Blalock Seafood & Specialty Market provides steamed meal solutions with all your favorite seafood products. Why Choose Us? Locally owned and operated market carries the freshest seafood in the region. Known for shrimp from fertile waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Over 10 years in business, flexible hours, convenient access to quality products, knowledgeable staff. Voted People's Choice Award for Best Seafood Market. Fresh Seafood & Beyond. Delivering fresh seafood to local areas including Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Foley. Gourmet Seasonings, Gourmet Dry Rubs, Fine Cheese. Try Our Famous Shrimp! Give us a call today to ask about our large selection of fresh seafood or to discuss the gourmet spices and fine cheeses we offer. Recommend stopping by to try our famous shrimp bisque and smoked tuna dip. Testimonials. Super friendly staff, clean, with a large assortment of seafood. Try the Tuna Dip and frozen hush puppies. Lots of dips and marinades. Awesome, large and meaty crab legs! Decent prices and amazing food. Made for a great date night. Home Services What We Have Fresh Fish Steam Room Shrimp Contact.
